k8s.cis.avoid_use_of_system_masters_grou.summary: Review and remove observed system:masters Group subjects from owned RBAC bindings; separately review unobserved certificate and provider group memberships.
steps: Confirm the affected binding IDs in the complete collected RBAC inventory.
Remove the system:masters Group subject from owned RoleBindings and ClusterRoleBindings and assign scoped roles to named groups as approved.
Review certificate and provider group memberships separately; this declaration check does not establish their absence.
Inspect the observed cronjob_effective_runtime_default_seccomp PodSpec and each regular/init container securityContext.seccompProfile.type; a container value overrides the Pod-level value.
Test the workload with RuntimeDefault in a staging environment; seccomp may block system calls required by this image.
Update the owning manifest or controller template at Pod or container level, roll out in a maintenance window, and verify readiness and the new declaration.
If workloads fail, revert the owned manifest and redeploy the prior revision while the service owner investigates blocked calls.

Test required service paths before rollout because NetworkPolicy restrictions can interrupt workloads; deploy and verify traffic, then revert the manifest if a required path fails.

steps: Inspect the Deployment Available condition, desired and available replica counts, and controller events for the named workload.
Correct the workload image, scheduling, probes, or capacity issue in the owning manifest after an operator review; avoid scaling or rollout changes without a recovery plan.
Verify Available=True and availableReplicas >= spec.replicas after rollout; revert the prior release if availability worsens.
k8s_deployment_available_condition.summary: Restore the observed Deployment replica availability.

steps: Review spec.rules[].host and spec.tls[].hosts/secretName for the affected Ingress.
Update the owning Ingress manifest so each rule host has a matching TLS host and an existing same-namespace TLS Secret; verify certificate coverage separately.
Roll out through the Ingress owner, verify controller configuration and client TLS behavior, and revert the manifest if traffic fails.
k8s_ingress_sni_hosts.summary: Bind each declared Ingress rule host to a TLS Secret name.

steps: Inspect the Ingress rule hosts, TLS host lists and Secret names, and confirm a complete metadata-only Secret inventory for the same namespace.
Have the workload owner provision or rotate a kubernetes.io/tls Secret through the approved secret manager, then update the owned Ingress manifest so every required host names that Secret.
Roll out with the Ingress controller owner, verify certificate selection and application connectivity, and restore the prior manifest if cutover fails.
k8s_ingress_tls_configured.summary: Declare matching Ingress TLS hosts and an existing same-namespace TLS Secret.

steps: Inspect Node status.addresses for ExternalIP and confirm its assigned cloud network address; this result does not establish a reachable endpoint.
With the cluster/network owner, plan private node pool replacement or approved exposure controls and migrate workloads before changing the address.
Verify Node addresses and workload health after migration; retain a tested rollback to the prior pool if services fail.
k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.summary: Review globally routable ExternalIP advertised by the Node.

steps: Inspect status.podIP and podIPs and confirm the CNI address allocation; this result does not prove a route or inbound reachability.
With the network owner, design private Pod CIDR allocation and safe workload rescheduling before changing CNI settings.
Test application communication and verify Pod IPs after migration; revert the approved network change if connectivity fails.
k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.summary: Review globally routable Pod IP advertised in Pod status.

field_binding.path: complete Pod inventory, metadata.namespace, current cluster-bound approved_namespaces

k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.summary: Declare the Pod or controller in an owner-approved namespace and review tenant isolation separately.
steps: Confirm the current Pod namespace and the fresh owner-approved namespace set.
Update the owned Pod or controller manifest to an approved namespace and roll out through the normal change process.
Recollect placement evidence and review tenant isolation separately; namespace membership alone is not isolation proof.

field_binding.path: complete rolebinding and clusterrolebinding inventory, current cluster-bound required subject and role policy

k8s_response_team_required_binding.summary: Declare the owner-required User or Group RBAC binding in an allowed namespace, then verify response access separately.
steps: Confirm the required User or Group, role, and allowed namespace in the fresh cluster-bound owner policy.
Create or correct the matching RBAC binding with the Kubernetes RBAC API group and verify its subject identity.
Validate effective response access separately; ServiceAccount requirements remain UNKNOWN until trusted policy can identify a namespace.
Inspect metadata.deletionTimestamp and finalizers for the named Secret; do not read or print Secret data.
Confirm whether deletion is intended and whether workloads still reference the Secret; Kubernetes does not allow deletionTimestamp to be unset.

If still needed, arrange safe recreation through the approved secret manager and update dependent workload references, then verify availability; reverse any changed workload manifest if cutover fails.
k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.summary: Review the Secret pending-deletion state with its owner.

steps: Inspect the Service spec.ports entry and confirm with the application owner whether it actually carries FTP or another protocol.
If FTP is used, plan an approved encrypted replacement and client migration; then update the owning Service and workload manifests to remove TCP port 21.
Verify authorized clients after rollout and revert the manifest if a required dependency breaks.
k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.summary: Review ClusterIP Service TCP port 21 declaration.
